description: qFoldIT Toolbelt for Unity — plugin registry. Format mirrors UEFN Toolbelt's registry.json.
transport: in-process (Unity MCP McpToolRegistry, no external bridge)

plugins.name: Animation Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Create AnimatorControllers, states, transitions, parameters, and attach them to objects.

plugins.name: Asset Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: List, instantiate, and find project assets by type and name.

plugins.name: Audio Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: AudioSource setup, one-shot playback, mixer groups, listener management, reverb zones.

plugins.name: Camera Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Create cameras, dependency-free follow behaviour, clipping planes, background, screenshots.

plugins.name: CodeGen Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Generates a MonoBehaviour with real, bindable public fields for named scene objects.

plugins.name: Component Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Reflection-based generic add/remove/get/set/list for any component type.

plugins.name: Console & Build Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Execute menu items, trigger player builds, read console log entry count.

plugins.name: Interaction Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Real interaction realization: attaches a working, pre-compiled QFoldITInteractable component (click-wired UnityEvent) for any of the 10 gameplay mechanics or legacy triggers.

plugins.name: Lighting Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Create lights, set skybox/ambient/fog, bake lightmaps, apply full lighting presets.

plugins.name: Material Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: 12 material presets, bulk swap by name match, team-color split, preset listing.

plugins.name: Measurement Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Distance between objects, per-object bounds, and full-scene bounds.

plugins.name: Navigation Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Bake NavMesh, add agents/obstacles, set runtime pathing destinations.

plugins.name: Particle Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: 7 particle system presets (fire, smoke, explosion, sparkle, rain, snow, magic) plus fine control.

plugins.name: Physics Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Rigidbody/collider setup, physics materials, joints, raycasts, global gravity.

plugins.name: Post-Processing Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: URP Volume/VolumeProfile setup: bloom, vignette, color adjustments, depth of field.

plugins.name: Prefab Workflow Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Create prefabs from scene objects, apply/revert overrides, unpack instances.

plugins.name: Procedural Placement & Arena
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: 8 geometric placement patterns (grid, circle, arc, spiral, line, wave, helix, radial) plus a symmetrical arena generator.

plugins.name: Project Setup
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Standard folder scaffold plus a boilerplate GameManager singleton MonoBehaviour.

plugins.name: Multi-Scene Management Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Create, load, unload, activate, and save scenes in a multi-scene setup.

plugins.name: Scene Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Spawn, transform, clone, delete, parent, list, and find GameObjects in the active scene.

plugins.name: Scientific Visualization Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Real scientific-state visualization: mechanic-differentiated visible anchors with optional world-space labels, plus QFoldITScientificBinding components for live scientific-state URIs.

plugins.name: Stamp Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Save a selection as a reusable stamp; place it anywhere with rotation; list saved stamps.

plugins.name: Tags & Layers Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Create and assign tags and layers, including recursive layer assignment.

plugins.name: Terrain Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Create terrain, sculpt hills/craters, flatten, paint textures, scatter trees.

plugins.name: UAG Bridge Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Validates and realizes qFoldIT Universal Assembly Graphs by calling this toolbelt's own tools — the Universal World Interface adapter connecting Unity to the rest of the qFoldIT stack.

plugins.name: UI Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Build uGUI Canvas hierarchies: buttons, text, panels, sliders, images, anchor presets.

plugins.name: Editor Utility Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Batch rename, Game view screenshots, Editor undo/redo.

plugins.name: World State Export
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Exports the full scene graph (names, components, transforms, parents) to JSON for AI context.
